_note: Qwen-Image 2.1 editing a picture (ADR 0021), from ComfyUI's template image_qwen_image_2_1_image_edit (25 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple; the reference at a 1024² pixel budget, resolution 1024, as ComfyUI sizes it; the template starts at 0, its own size, which came out over-sharpened and grainy wherever the picture was repainted, docs/research/image-models.md), without its prompt enhancer, on Qwen-Image 2.1's own files. The picture is the reference (TextEncodeQwenImage21). The painted area is the latent's noise mask: the sampler repaints only it, the picture's own latent holding the rest, so the edit lands where it's painted; the picture is then pasted back outside it (ImageCompositeMasked), so nothing else moves. With nothing painted, comfyui.ts drops mask, encode, masked and composite, and the whole picture is repainted. $names are filled in by server/images/comfyui/comfyui.ts. Attention is Comfy Kitchen's int8 (ModelAttentionBackend), as Ming-Image's template has it: less time sampling on an NVIDIA card (docs/research/image-models.md), PyTorch's attention where it can't run, as on a Mac. The picture is first scaled to that budget ($fitWidth × $fitHeight, worked out in comfyui.ts as mflux does) and encoded as the canvas, so the painted area's surroundings are the picture; the result is scaled back to the picture's size ($width × $height) before it is pasted back or saved.
